Meanwhile, a worker on a Greek-owned oil tanker was killed in an apparent missile attack in the Persian Gulf, its owner said on November 6, after Tehran said ships that had hit mines had been set ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz.

The Athens-based owner said the fire was likely caused by an unidentified projectile striking the ship. Full details were not immediately available.
